# FFI / cdylib Variants

When the Rust project includes FFI crates (e.g. `crate-type = ["cdylib"]`), additional tools are needed.

## cbindgen (C header generation)

Add `rust-cbindgen` to `devenv.nix`:

```nix
packages = [
  pkgs.rust-cbindgen  # NOT pkgs.cbindgen
];
```

### cbindgen.toml example

```toml
[export]
include = ["MyStruct", "MyEnum"]

[fn]
prefix = "MY_API"

[parse]
parse_deps = false

header = """
/* Auto-generated by cbindgen. Do not edit. */
"""

language = "C"
```

### Generate headers

```bash
cbindgen --config cbindgen.toml --crate my-ffi --output include/my_api.h
```

## Unity / C# interop

For Unity native plugins, the cdylib output goes to `Assets/Plugins/`:

```bash
cargo build --release
cp target/release/libmy_ffi.dylib ../Assets/Plugins/libmy_ffi.bundle  # macOS
```

## Package name gotcha

| Tool | nixpkgs name | Common mistake |
|------|-------------|----------------|
| cbindgen | `pkgs.rust-cbindgen` | `pkgs.cbindgen` (does not exist) |

Always verify with: `nix search nixpkgs <keyword>`
